units.source_text: 柏木说着从衣兜里把折叠得整整齐齐的措据——

en.t: As Kashiwagi spoke, he took from his jacket pocket the neatly folded promissory notes--

units.source_text: 这些借据他总是放在衣兜里——掏了出来，摊开让我看了看。

en.t: the notes he always kept in that pocket--pulled them out, unfolded them, and showed them to me.

units.source_text: 我刚要伸手去拿，他慌忙地守好又放回衣兜里，大概是怕我把它弄破了吧。

en.t: Just as I reached out to take them, he hurriedly guarded them and put them back into his pocket, probably afraid that I might tear them.

units.source_text: 我的眼睛里只留下了刺眼的朱红色拇指纹的残像。

en.t: Only the afterimage of the glaring vermilion thumbprints remained in my eyes.

units.source_text: 我的指纹显得格外的凄惨。
